title: Why are most people right-handed?
text:
Fascinating! had no idea people (scientists) study these things!  It appears that right-handed is the "correct" and normative way and is associated with larger left brains! Evolutionary data over 6M years is supportive! I was screwed as I am a leftie. This may be true for politics as well? Oh, well!
